description: Map a plain-language or unfamiliar request to the right Mencoro metric and tool. Returns each metric with its everyday synonyms, unit, value range, whether higher or lower is better, the tool that serves it, and example questions. Call this first when a request is vague, non-technical, phrased in another language, or uses wording that does not match a tool name. Static reference; no project data.
name: get_metric_glossary
title: Metric glossary
